**Finding submitted: MISSING (insurance clause absent).**

- **Investigation:** Keyword and regex searches ("insurance", "insur|coverage|policy|policies|underwrit") returned zero hits; I also read the full body (Sections 1–10, including Warranties, Confidentiality and all of General Provisions) to confirm no coverage covenant exists anywhere, and no definition of insured obligations lurks in the fee, term or indemnity-adjacent text.
- **Why actionable:** HDI stores and operates the Site on its own systems and is exposed to Company Content, user information and data (p0009, p0048) — a hosting vendor with no insurance at all is walk-away territory under this rule.
- **Cure:** One `insert_after` p0070 adding Section 10.9 (Insurance) in the General Provisions, immediately before the signature block, carrying exactly the six preferred elements — CGL USD 1M/occurrence and USD 2M aggregate, E&O USD 2M, cyber/privacy USD 5M where HDI processes any data belonging to, supplied by or processed for the Company, statutory workers' compensation, and certificates on request. Non-element extras from the model language ("at its own expense", one-year post-term tail) were omitted, and the cyber trigger was drafted broadly rather than narrowed to named data examples. Fallback (E&O USD 1M / cyber USD 2M) flagged in the comment as a negotiating step.
